notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible noncreature permanent.
description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting any indestructible noncreature permanent you control.
Ral triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent or planeswalker.
Allow Chain of Acid to resolve, failing to destroy the indestructible permanent and copying the spell targeting the same permanent.
Repeat from step 2.
